verdict.rationale: Vast.ai advertises NVIDIA GB200 availability, which is a current-generation Blackwell datacenter GPU. Its marketplace search filters by GPU type. Cheaper previous-generation cards such as the RTX 4090, RTX 3090 and A100 PCIe appear in the docs and in community pricing reports. missing for 10: explicit evidence of H100/H200/B200 listings, documentation of the GPU catalog and availability depth, and independent hands-on confirmation of renting current-gen datacenter GPUs.
